persisted_as: {state_dir}/decision_ledger.json (a dict keyed by decision_id, full-file JSON rewrite -- same pattern as LifecycleState)

fields.decision_id: stable_id(...) -- deterministic per (kind, symbol, bar/signal timestamp); the cross-reference key every other ledger (notification, shadow) links back to
fields.event_id: today identical to decision_id (one decision, one record) -- kept as a distinct field so a future many-events-per-decision model does not require a schema change
fields.session_id: the live PIV session this decision belongs to (EventBus.session_id)
fields.runtime_sha: identity.runtime_sha, when available (cli.py always supplies it in production)
fields.reason_codes: list[str] -- decide()'s own explanatory reason codes, unmodified
fields.strategy_id: the QuantSignal's signal_type, when this decision originated from a published signal
fields.strategy_version: always null today -- no versioned strategy registry exists
fields.strategy_approval_status: UNVALIDATED for every real decision; APPROVED only ever appears in a TEST_FIXTURE_ONLY-labeled record
fields.data_provider: reserved, currently always null -- session_runner.py does not yet plumb a provider-identity string through to decide()
fields.entry_price: passthrough only, never fabricated (decision_contract's own invariant)
fields.paper_entry_enabled: the per-ticker PaperEntrySettings value AT DECISION TIME
fields.evidence_category: natural | observational | test_probe -- 'natural' for every real DecisionEngine call today (no observational/probe caller wired to this ledger yet -- see remaining_integration_work.md)
fields.decision_execution_status: decide()'s OWN ExecutionStatus (NO_ACTION/ENTRY_ELIGIBLE/ENTRY_BLOCKED_PAPER_DISABLED/ENTRY_BLOCKED_UNVALIDATED_STRATEGY/EXIT_ELIGIBLE), fixed at decision time
fields.notification_status: NOT_APPLICABLE | PENDING | RETRY | SENT | FAILED | UNCERTAIN -- mutated by NotificationOutbox as delivery proceeds (see alert_delivery_contract.md); NOT_APPLICABLE for a decision classify() found not alert-worthy
fields.shadow_status: reserved for a future direct write-back from ShadowLedger (today ShadowLedger is queried independently by decision_id rather than writing back into this field -- see remaining_integration_work.md)
fields.execution_status: reserved for a future direct write-back of the real order_intent/apply_broker_update outcome (today that is queried from LifecycleState/piv_events.jsonl by correlation_id, not mirrored into this field -- see remaining_integration_work.md)

invariants: record() is idempotent per decision_id -- a duplicate call (restart, retry) returns the EXISTING record unchanged, never overwriting notification_status/shadow_status/etc. already set.

An eligible BUY (recommendation==BUY) remains recorded even when decision_execution_status==ENTRY_BLOCKED_PAPER_DISABLED or the subsequent order_intent call raises PaperGuardError -- the record reflects the DECISION, not the outcome.
No level (entry_price/stop_price/target_price) is ever fabricated -- always a direct passthrough from decision_contract.Decision, which itself never invents one.
